selection_order: Event candidates were ranked from saved SQL before official sources were searched. Search began from dates, not a proposed explanation.

sources.title: Trading conduct report 2-8 August 2026
sources.supported_context: EA connects the Tuesday evening high prices with thermal availability problems and reports an earlier reserve and wind forecast shortfall. It also reports that Ruakaka was depleted during the evening high-price periods.
sources.qualification: Relevant contemporaneous context for the selected evening, not a causal estimate from this project's data. Node/dispatch prices differ from Offtake-weighted National half-hours. The report's sections give inconsistent Huntly trip timing; do not assert an exact trip time. Storage output here is not state of charge.

sources.title: Trading conduct report 31 August-6 September 2025
sources.supported_context: EA describes declining Saturday wind and dispatch of thermal peakers in low-wind conditions.
sources.qualification: Day-level corroborating context, not proof of the cause of the entire selected morning event. The project does not contain wind forecasts, offers or dispatch counterfactuals.

sources.title: Trading conduct report 1-7 March 2026
sources.supported_context: EA attributes Tuesday and Wednesday morning Fernhill and Tuai node spikes to Hawke's Bay line constraints, with further monitoring indicated.
sources.qualification: Official node-level context consistent with investigating the CNI separation. No node-to-Zone contribution decomposition was performed; do not claim the entire Zone spread was caused by this constraint.

sources.title: Trading conduct report 29 March-4 April 2026
sources.supported_context: EA discusses forecast differences around some Monday high prices.
sources.qualification: No exact attribution to the selected 03:30 half-hour was established from the reviewed text. Retain the event as a descriptive counterexample with its cause unresolved.

rejected_context: Weekly index labels did not always match PDF covered dates. Reports for 9-15 August, 8-14 March and 5-11 April were inspected but not used for events in the preceding week. PDF internal date range controls. No additional raw data acquired.
